purchase-agent.description: Customer-facing purchase agent. May add new subscriptions and cancel existing ones in the Billing SoR. Cannot modify product prices or trigger billing recalculations.

catalogue-admin.description: Product catalogue administrator. May update product list prices in the Catalogue SoR and trigger bulk billing recalculations. Cannot directly modify customer subscription records.

system-admin.description: System administrator with full write access across all SoRs. Intended for operational tasks, demo teardown, and break-glass scenarios.
